decisions.reason: A fifteen-day express program builds directly on Teckentrup's existing production and logistics knowledge, so it is easy to run and to learn from, though it may later be merged into broader express offerings.

A seventy-two-hour delivery program draws on established manufacturing and stock know-how, and its demand data are easy to interpret, though the very short lead time is costly and may be consolidated.
The fire-resistant exterior door extends the core Teckentrup 62 modular fire door system and already has European approval, so it fits squarely within the firm's existing technical knowledge.
The express program for doors and gates has a dedicated page and applies the firm's logistics expertise across its core product range, making it a strategic service to keep.
The online ordering and digital services platform supports the established dealer business, and its usage data give rich feedback the firm can absorb to improve it.
The fire and smoke protection door is a core competence product closely tied to existing certification and engineering knowledge.
